name: Chat with the AI tutor
description: Verifies the user can send a Japanese message and receive a tutor reply with reading and Indonesian translation.
steps: Type a Japanese greeting in the message box
expected: The user message appears and a tutor reply in Japanese appears below it with an Indonesian translation.

name: Generate and flip flashcards
description: Verifies flashcards can be generated for a topic, flipped, and marked as memorized.
steps: Tap the card to flip it
expected: A card shows a Japanese word, flips to show its reading and meaning, and the next card (Kartu 2 dari 8) is shown after pressing Hafal.

name: Take a JLPT quiz
description: Verifies a quiz can be started and answering shows feedback with an explanation.
expected: Answer options are highlighted as correct or wrong and an explanation with a next-question button is visible.

name: Correct a Japanese sentence
description: Verifies a sentence can be corrected with a grammar explanation.
steps: Type a Japanese sentence into the text area
expected: A corrected sentence, a more natural version, and grammar points in Indonesian are displayed.

name: Reject empty sentence correction
description: Verifies an empty correction request is blocked with a visible message.
expected: A message asking to write a Japanese sentence first is visible and no result card is shown.
